name: Panda Dairy Corporation
summary: Established in 1996 and headquartered in Wenzhou, China, Panda Dairy Corporation is actively involved in the research, development, manufacturing, and distribution of dairy products. The company's operations serve both the domestic Chinese market and international territories. Operating under its proprietary "Panda" brand, the corporation offers a comprehensive selection of products. This extensive range includes various cheeses, such as mozzarella and convenient cheese sticks, alongside different formulations of evaporated milk, like modulated and full-fat options. Their portfolio also features a variety of condensed milks, specifically reconstituted sweetened, modified sweetened, and standard sweetened types. Furthermore, Panda Dairy provides coconut juice, light cream, and a unique sweetened milk sauce.
